description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your marked target critically fails an attack roll or a saving throw against you.

You have been setting this one up since the first time it swung at you.

Make a melee Strike against it that automatically hits and is a critical hit. This Strike does not count toward your multiple attack penalty and does not cost an action. You may not use this in the first round of an encounter — the duel has to have been running for you to have been setting anything up.

cinderfall.incomplete: On the mark critically failing against the caster: an auto-hit, auto-crit melee Strike against it at no MAP cost, not usable round 1. No rule element guarantees an outright hit or crit, compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
